vetSays.line: You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Desmond just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Marcus.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Dmitri.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Marcus of The Red Table with 2 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Marcus of The Red Table raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Marcus of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Desmond speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

🥣 Ellis of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Ellis waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
A mother from The Red Table pressed a carved token into your hand: "for the winter you fed us." You didn't know there was a winter you'd fed.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
